description: Create a shareable preview link for a saved R3 project, so a person can open it in a browser and see it running. The link is valid for 7 days and does NOT make the project public; making a new one is free. It is how the user sees what you built. Takes the projectId returned by r3_project_create. When an R3 tab has the project open, the project's picture (its card and the link's image) is refreshed from that tab.

projectId.description: The project id, as returned by r3_project_create.

name: r3_preview_create

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.
